Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G4599; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral):--more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).
BiblicalUsage: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak, and Jesus said it to disciples who could not watch one hour with Him. God chose the weak things of the world to confound the mighty, the weaker members of the body are necessary, and Christ died for the ungodly when we were yet without strength.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chooses weakness on purpose, because it leaves no doubt about whose power is at work. The flesh will always be weak, and I hold that the answer is not to pretend otherwise but to watch and pray.
